author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In 2023, Adam Savage inherited racks and racks of model-making bits and bobs from the former ILM model shop, and since then, many former colleagues have stopped by to tour or use the hardware inside. Don Bies, former ILM model supervisor and LucasFilm archivist, is the latest guest, marveling over the racks he knew so well, sharing stories from his many years at ILM and Lucasfilm, and reminiscing with Adam about their shared tenure at the infamous model shop!
